description: Work out the least notice that ends a periodic private tenancy, and the earliest end date it can name, in any UK nation, whether the tenant or the landlord gives it. It also says when a landlord cannot end the tenancy by notice at all (England) or must apply to a tribunal (Scotland).

given.description: The day the notice is given, as YYYY-MM-DD. In Scotland, the day the other side receives it.

nation.description: The UK nation the home is in.

period.description: How often the rent falls due.

rentDueDate.description: For weekly or four-weekly rent: a day rent fell due, such as the last due date, as YYYY-MM-DD; rent periods repeat every 7 or 28 days from it. Leave it out only if they repeat from the day the tenancy started.

rentDueDay.description: For monthly rent: the day of the month rent falls due, such as 1 or 31. Leave it out only if it is the day of the month the tenancy started.

tenancyStart.description: The day the tenancy, or in Wales the occupation contract, began, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: check_notice_period
title: Notice period check
